# Telex Business Support Services Inc. (TelexPH)

> Philippine-based BPO specializing in AI-integrated business support and certified GoHighLevel (GHL) administration for global marketing agencies.

TelexPH (Telex Business Support Services Inc.) provides offshore staffing and automation. We combine certified GoHighLevel (GHL) expertise with AI systems to optimize CRMs, funnels, and operations for scaling businesses.

## Core Services
- **AI-Powered Business Support**: Automation that reduces manual work in global operations.
- **GHL Administration**: Certified management, CRM optimization, and funnel building.
- **Offshore Staffing**: Professional teams in the Philippines trained in systems thinking.

## Key Information
- **Location**: Guimba, Philippines
- **USP**: We combine GHL certification with AI efficiency to optimize systems, not just manage them.
- **Sitemap**: https://www.telexph.com/sitemap.xml
- **Crawler Policy**: Optimized for GPT-5 and GPT-5 Mini. Full access granted to all public documentation and service pages.
- **Entity Data**: Schema.org (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service) implemented for clear entity resolution.

## FAQ
- **What problem does TelexPH solve?** We remove scaling friction with smart offshore teams that use AI and human workflows.
- **Who is this for?** Marketing agencies and enterprises needing CRM management and affordable staffing.
- **How does TelexPH use AI?** We automate repetitive tasks within GHL and CRM environments to boost efficiency.
